steps.entry_conditions: Invocation supplies a project, at least one explicitly selected specification, and requested scope.
steps.action: Resolve environment and project identity in the real shell; read applicable project instructions; select and bind the literal evidence destination before first write; capture bounded context.
outputs: bound evidence root and output mapping
steps.completion_evidence: context record containing selected_evidence_value, selection_source, resolved_evidence_root and output mapping (context.md:15-17, evidence-resume.md:9)
steps.failure_route: context.md:13 ask once with AskUserQuestion when no destination resolves; context.md:15 an ambiguous or unavailable destination is a precise gap, not permission to default.

steps.entrypoint: SKILL.md 'Workflow' item 2 -> references/context.md 'Read and account for requirements'
steps.action: Inventory every requirement with stable source-qualified IDs; resolve constitutional decisions, shared-contract ownership, dependency edges and material gaps.
steps.completion_evidence: every selected requirement carries an ID and a verification method or a precise gap (context.md:29, implementation.md:11)
steps.failure_route: context.md:33,35 source-qualified conflicts and absent prerequisites raise a specific AskUserQuestion, then independent work continues.
steps.terminal_user_outcome: An explicit request for a material decision is a permitted terminal outcome here.

steps.entrypoint: SKILL.md 'Workflow' item 3 -> references/implementation.md 'Inspect for reuse, then plan'
steps.action: Search for existing responsibility before adding one; record reuse/extend/compose/new with references; plan dependency-ordered slices.
steps.completion_evidence: slice plan rows carry requirement IDs, contracts, owned scope and verification (implementation.md:9-11)
steps.failure_route: implementation.md:19 absent tooling resolves to the project-prescribed toolchain or a material decision; language substitution to evade missing tools is prohibited.
steps.terminal_user_outcome: Plan-only requests stop here and deliver the plan (SKILL.md 'Scope and inputs').

steps.action: Per behavioral slice write a failing test, preserve the failure, implement minimum real behavior, rerun, refactor, then integrate in dependency order.
steps.completion_evidence: one append-only JSONL line per actual attempt with exact command, exit/timeout and stream locators (evidence-resume.md:22)
steps.failure_route: implementation.md:25 prerequisite failures are not valid red; implementation.md:33 a contradictory expectation stops the dependent change instead of being rewritten.

steps.entrypoint: SKILL.md 'Workflow' item 4 -> references/implementation.md 'QA and metrics' / 'Native and external behavior'
steps.action: Declare candidate, required-case set, metric definitions, exclusions, thresholds and platforms before measuring; run applicable checks; run required native cases on their declared host when available.
outputs: raw measurements, counts and per-platform results in assets/delivery.md
steps.completion_evidence: declared denominator with each required case counted once; missing measurement recorded unperformed (implementation.md:43-47)
steps.failure_route: implementation.md:51 an unavailable native host yields named unperformed cases and a partial result, never an inferred pass.

steps.entry_conditions: Checks have final observations or explicit unperformed reasons.
steps.action: Reread the original destination selection and read back each promised file at its actual path; account for every requirement; choose one overall status.
steps.completion_evidence: required-versus-actual path table with a supporting observation (failure-delivery.md:17)
steps.failure_route: failure-delivery.md:17 a wrong root, missing file or unresolved selection conflict leaves the task PARTIAL or BLOCKED.
steps.terminal_user_outcome: Usable outcome: a delivery report with an honest status, plus separately reported external acceptance or NOT_EVALUATED (failure-delivery.md:29).

steps.entry_conditions: Cross-cutting; applies after meaningful verified progress, before yielding unfinished work, and on a user-selected resume.
steps.action: Write checkpoints; on resume verify current identity, mark stale results, reconcile owned jobs, preserve other actors' changes, record drift and the next safe action.
steps.completion_evidence: six-step resume sequence with drift and carried-forward evidence recorded (evidence-resume.md:30-37)
steps.failure_route: evidence-resume.md:39 a checkpoint is navigation, not truth; no rollback or completion claim without actual evidence.
steps.terminal_user_outcome: Concrete next safe action with retained evidence.
